script.title: PEANUT-FREE LUNCH
script.scene_zh: 學校餐廳 · 安排過敏餐
script.story_hook: A mom plans a safe first school lunch.
script.intro_zh: 一位媽媽，為孩子安排第一頓校園午餐。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we arrange a peanut-free school lunch. Listen for allergy forms and rules.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們安排無花生的學校午餐。留意過敏表單的問句與規定。
script.outro: Form filed, tray labeled, table purple. Lunch solved!
script.outro_zh: 表單交了、餐盤標了、紫色桌定好，午餐沒煩惱！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each lunch counter line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀午餐室的常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her early forties with dark brown hair in a quick bun, wearing a cherry red raincoat over a gray sweater, black leggings and brown boots, holding a clipboard, serious but warm
script.char_b_description: a big man in his fifties with a shaved head and a thick gray mustache, wearing a white chef coat, a denim apron with tomato stains and clean sneakers, friendly eyes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm here about the lunch program.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hɪɹ əˈbaʊt ðə lʌntʃ ˈpɹɑɡɹæm/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我想問學校午餐的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Are you a parent or a student?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɑɹ ju ə ˈpɛɹənt ɔɹ ə ˈstudənt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。你是家長，還是新同學？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parent. My son starts school Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛɹənt maɪ sʌn stɑɹts skul ˈmʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 家長。我兒子週一開學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome. What can I do for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm wʌt kæn aɪ du fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎。需要我幫什麼忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Theo has a peanut allergy. A serious one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθiˌoʊ hæz ə ˈpinˌnʌt ˈælɜɹdʒi ə ˈsɪɹiəs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: Theo 對花生過敏，而且很嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we see that a lot. First, this form.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wi si ðæt ə lɑt fɜɹst ðɪs fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們常遇到這種情況。先填這張單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All about the allergy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl əˈbaʊt ði ˈælɜɹdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 表單都是過敏的事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes: foods, reactions, and his doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fuz ɹiˈækʃənz ænd hɪz ˈdɑktɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對：食物、反應，還有他的醫生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peanuts, tree nuts... and cashews too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpinˌnʌs tɹi nʌts ænd kəˈʃuz tu/
dialogue.zh: 花生、樹堅果…腰果也不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Does he carry an EpiPen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt dʌz hi ˈkæɹi æn ˈɛpəˌpɛn/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。他會自帶急救筆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, in his backpack. Two of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn hɪz ˈbækˌpæk tu ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 會，書包裡有兩支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. The nurse keeps a spare, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə nɜɹs kips ə spɛɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 很好。護理室那邊也備有一支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The nurse? Where is her office?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɜɹs wɛɹ ɪz hɜɹ ˈɔfəs/
dialogue.zh: 護士？她的護理室在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hall B, by the gym. Look for a red heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɔl bi baɪ ðə dʒɪm lʊk fɚ ə ɹɛd hɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: B走廊，體育館旁。門上找紅心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll have him memorize it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl hæv hɪm ˈmɛməɹˌaɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會叫他背起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, about his lunch tray itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ əˈbaʊt hɪz lʌntʃ tɹeɪ aɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 接著講他的午餐餐盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he eat school lunch at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi it skul lʌntʃ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 他到底能不能吃學校午餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. We'll build him a safe one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs wil bɪld hɪm ə seɪf wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 當然。我們會替他配一頓安全的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A special tray? Different from the others?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈspɛʃəl tɹeɪ ˈdɪfɚənt fɹʌm ði ˈʌðɚz/
dialogue.zh: 特製餐盤？和其他人不一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same menu, minus the risky dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈmɛnju ˈmaɪnəs ðə ˈɹɪski ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 菜單一樣，只是避開危險的菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you stop mix-ups by mistake?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju stɑp ˈmɪksˈʌps baɪ mɪˈsteɪk/
dialogue.zh: 你們怎麼避免拿錯餐盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A labeled tray — his name, in bold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈleɪbld tɹeɪ hɪz neɪm ɪn boʊld/
dialogue.zh: 餐盤上貼標籤，用粗體寫他的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His name on the tray. Oh, how cute.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz neɪm ɑn ðə tɹeɪ oʊ haʊ kjut/
dialogue.zh: 名字寫在餐盤上。噢，好可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one more rule: he'll sit purple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn mɔɹ ɹul hil sɪt ˈpɜɹpəl̩/
dialogue.zh: 還有一條規定：他坐紫色桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit purple? What does that mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ˈpɜɹpəl̩ wʌt dʌz ðæt min/
dialogue.zh: 坐紫色？是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Table four, purple mat — the allergy table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪbl̩ fɔɹ ˈpɜɹpəl̩ mæt ði ˈælɜɹdʒi ˈteɪbl̩/
dialogue.zh: 四號桌，紫色桌墊—就是過敏專用桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nobody eats peanuts at that table?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈnʌboʊd its ˈpinˌnʌts æt ðæt ˈteɪbl̩/
dialogue.zh: 所以那桌沒有人吃花生？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That table is peanut-free, every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈteɪbl̩ ɪz ˈpinˌnʌt fɹi ˈɛvɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那張桌每天都是無花生區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you wipe tables between lunches?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju waɪp ˈteɪbl̩z bəˈtwin ˈlʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 午餐中間你會擦拭桌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wipe all tables, twice a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi waɪp ɔl ˈteɪbl̩z kwaɪs ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所有桌子一天擦兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That honestly helps so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈɑnəstli hɛlps soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這幫了大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small catch, though. Today's menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɑl kætʃ ðoʊ təˈdeɪz ˈmɛnju/
dialogue.zh: 不過有個小狀況：今天的菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about it? I don't know the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ɪt aɪ doʊnt noʊ ðə ˈmɛnju/
dialogue.zh: 菜單怎麼了？我還沒看過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday's special: peanut chicken stir-fry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹzdeɪz ˈspɛʃəl̩ ˈpinˌnʌt ˈtʃɪkən ˈstɜɹˌflaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週四特餐：花生雞丁炒飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peanut sauce in the cafeteria?! Oh my.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpinˌnʌt sɔs ɪn ðə kæˈfɛtɹiə oʊ maɪ/
dialogue.zh: 餐廳裡有花生醬？！天呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry. It's off the menu now.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈwɜɹi ɪts ɔf ðə ˈmɛnju naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心。這道菜已經拿掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off? Just because of our form?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf dʒʌst bɪˈkɔz ʌv ˈaʊɚ fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 拿掉了？就是因為我們這張單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen swaps it: sunflower seed butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃən swæps ɪt ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ sid ˈbʌtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 廚房自動換成葵花籽醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunflower... is that like peanut butter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚ ɪz ðæt laɪk ˈpinˌnʌt ˈbʌtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 葵花醬？像花生醬那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same taste, safe. Theo's class will love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm teɪst seɪf ˈθiˌoʊz klæs wil lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 味道像，但是安全。他們班會愛上它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Theo will be the coolest kid there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθiˌoʊ wil bi ðə kulɪst kɪd ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: Theo 會是班上最神氣的小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Maybe famous, even.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ meɪbi ˈfeɪməs ivən/
dialogue.zh: 哈！說不定還會紅呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should other parents know about him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ˈʌðɚ ˈpɛɹənts noʊ əˈbaʊt hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 其他家長會知道他的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We tell each class: no nuts in lunches.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɛl itʃ klæs noʊ nʌts ɪn ˈlʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們會跟每個班說：午餐不要帶堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a friend shares a cookie?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ə fɹɛnd ʃɛɹz ə ˈkʊki/
dialogue.zh: 那如果有同學分他餅乾呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great question. We teach kids to ask first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈkwɛsʧən wi titʃ kɪdz tə æsk fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 問得好。我們教孩子：分享前要先問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's comforting. And field trips?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈkʌmfɚtɪŋ ænd field tɹɪps/
dialogue.zh: 聽了就安心。那校外教學呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pack his own, tell the bus monitor.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæk hɪz on tɛl ðə bʌs ˈmɑnətɚ/
dialogue.zh: 自備午餐，再跟隨車老師說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bus monitor... got it, I'm writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌs ˈmɑnətɚ ɡɑɾ ɪt aɪm ˈɹaɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 隨車老師…記下了，我正在寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more: birthday treats have a nut list.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ ˈbɜɹθˌdeɪ tɹits hæv ə nʌt lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 還有：生日點心有一份堅果清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no homemade peanut cookies for class?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ hoʊmˈmeɪnd ˈpinˌnʌt ˈkʊkiz fɚ klæs/
dialogue.zh: 所以不能在家烤花生餅乾帶去班上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct. Store-bought, checked labels.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈɹɛkt stɔɹˈbɔt tʃɛkt ˈleɪbəl̩z/
dialogue.zh: 對。買現成的，看清標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The school has the form now. Anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skul hæz ðə fɔɹm naʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 表單交給學校了。還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a photo, for his lunch account.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈfoʊtoʊ fɚ hɪz lʌntʃ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 只剩一張照片，給他的餐費帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To know his face at the register?
dialogue.phonetic: /tə noʊ hɪz feɪs æt ðə ˈɹɛdʒəstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是用來在收銀台認他的臉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly — faster than any list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈfæstɚ ðæn ˈɛni lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，比查名單還快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll love that. Thank you, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil lʌv ðæt θæŋk ju ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 他一定會喜歡。真的很感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keeping kids safe — that's the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkipɪŋ kɪdz seɪf ðæts ðə dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 守護孩子們的安全，就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday, purple table. See you then!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ˈpɜɹpəl̩ ˈteɪbl̩ si ju ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 週一，紫色桌。到時再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Monday! Send Dad by, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈmʌnˌdeɪ sɛnd dæd baɪ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週一再見！也請爸爸過來一趟，好嗎？

script.youtube_title_en: "He'll Sit Purple" — Arranging a Peanut-Free Lunch at the School Cafeteria
script.youtube_description:
60句學校餐廳聽力練習：孩子對花生過敏，開學第一頓午餐該怎麼安排？

這一集跟著一位媽媽走進學校午餐室，和餐廳經理從過敏表單聊到貼標餐盤、紫色過敏桌、菜單換菜、校外教學和生日點心的規則，一步一步把安全午餐敲定。

你會聽到：
- 描述過敏症狀與禁食清單的說法
- 餐盤貼標、座位規定的問答
- 菜單出問題時的處理與換菜
- 校外教學、分食餅乾的應對

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of school cafeteria listening practice: a son with a serious peanut allergy starts school Monday, so his mom sits down with the cafeteria manager to plan every safe detail.

You will hear how to fill out an allergy form, ask about labeled trays and seat rules, handle a peanut dish on the menu, and plan for field trips and birthday treats. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.youtube_description_ref:

孩子對花生過敏，學校的午餐還能安心吃嗎？座位、餐盤、菜單都要怎麼安排？

這一集帶大家走進學校午餐室，跟著一位媽媽和一位細心的餐廳經理，從過敏表單到紫色過敏桌，把一頓安全午餐的每一步聽懂、說會。

你會聽到：
📋 過敏表單：「Yes: foods, reactions, and his doctor.」
🍽️ 貼標餐盤：「A labeled tray — his name, in bold.」
💜 座位規定：「And one more rule: he'll sit purple.」

願每個孩子，都吃得安心、吃得開心。
